name: application-channel-header
title: Channel Header
description: Streaming channel header with gradient banner, avatar, formatted subscriber/video counts, and a real toggling subscribe button.
useWhen: Heading a channel or creator profile page on a video/streaming platform.
You need a subscribe/follow action whose label and style should visibly reflect the current subscribed state.
Subscriber counts are large enough to benefit from K/M-abbreviated formatting rather than a raw number.
avoidWhen: You need a generic authentication/profile card shell (sign-in, account switcher) — use `auth-card-shell` for that instead.
The channel has no banner imagery or subscriber concept — a simpler user header is enough.
You need to display more than a name, avatar, and two counts — move additional metadata to a dedicated about section.
responsiveBehavior: Fixed-width card (max-w-xl) with a fixed-height banner; name and counts truncate rather than wrapping onto the subscribe button at narrow widths.
accessibility: The subscribe button uses aria-pressed to reflect real toggled state, with its visible label ('Subscribe' vs. 'Subscribed') always matching that state.
Subscribed/unsubscribed styling changes both background color and border together, never relying on color alone.
Avatar and banner are decorative and marked appropriately; all channel identity is conveyed through real text content.

variants.title: Channel Header
variants.description: Systems Deep Dive channel, 284K subscribers, 312 videos, unsubscribed initial state with a working subscribe toggle.
accessibility: Subscribe button aria-pressed state and visible label are both derived from the same subscribed boolean.

variants.title: Channel Header (Dark)
variants.description: Channel header adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Subscribe button colors are tuned to meet WCAG AA contrast against the dark surface.
